s0401.literal: On bingxu day envoys came from the two countries of Samudra and Ma'dha to court.
s0401.idiomatic: On bingxu day envoys from Samudra and Ma'dha came to court.

s0402.literal: On gengyin day an edict ordered the troops campaigning against Jiaozhi: aside from retaining one hundred Mongol troops and four hundred Han troops as Prince Zhennan Tuohuan's bodyguard, the rest were all sent back; separately Mongol troops under the Jiang-Huai Branch Privy Council were assigned to garrison Jiangxi.
s0402.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict ordered the Jiaozhi campaign armies disbanded except for 100 Mongol and 400 Han troops retained as Prince Zhennan Tuohuan's bodyguard; Mongol troops under the Jiang-Huai branch privy council were separately assigned to garrison Jiangxi.

s0403.literal: On guisi day Yunnan presented local products as tribute.
s0403.idiomatic: On guisi day Yunnan presented local products as tribute.

s0404.literal: Wumeng rebelled; the Sichuan Branch Secretariat was ordered to dispatch Yesudai'er to lead troops against them, and Ma Hu prefectural magistrate Ruzuo provided three hundred tribal troops as support.
s0404.idiomatic: Wumeng rebelled; Yesudai'er of the Sichuan branch secretariat was ordered to lead troops against them, with Ma Hu prefectural magistrate Ruzuo supplying 300 tribal troops.

s0405.literal: Over one hundred households under Xiyamen chief Aze and others submitted.
s0405.idiomatic: More than 100 households under Xiyamen chief Aze and others submitted.

s0406.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jihai day five thousand ingots of paper currency were used for equitable purchase of grain at Yingchang Prefecture.
s0406.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jihai day 5,000 ingots of paper currency were used to purchase grain equitably at Yingchang Prefecture.

s0407.literal: The Hejian and Shandong Salt Tax Transport Commissions were again divided into two.
s0407.idiomatic: The Hejian and Shandong salt tax transport commissions were again divided in two.

s0408.literal: Hesen Haiya was dispatched as envoy to Annam.
s0408.idiomatic: Hesen Haiya was dispatched as envoy to Annam.

s0409.literal: Xuexuedejin was dispatched to lead one thousand Uighur households to garrison Helazhang.
s0409.idiomatic: Xuexuedejin was dispatched to lead 1,000 Uighur households to garrison Helazhang.

s0410.literal: On gengzi day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0410.idiomatic: On gengzi day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0411.literal: On jiachen day the Southern Peak Temple was repaired.
s0411.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Southern Peak Temple was repaired.

s0412.literal: On yisi day Privy Council officials said: "Tuotuomu'er sent a messenger saying the three divisions of Asha, Anü, and Aze wish to rebel; envoys should be sent to summon them, and if they do not come, attack when an opportunity arises.
s0412.idiomatic: On yisi day privy council officials said, "Tuotuomu'er sent word that the Asha, Anü, and Aze divisions wished to rebel; envoys should summon them, and if they did not come, attack when an opportunity arose.

s0413.literal: " The request was denied; an edict instructed them: "Matters not deliberated with Prince of Yunnan Yesun Temur must not be carried out on one's own.
s0413.idiomatic: " The request was denied, and an edict instructed them, "Matters not deliberated with Prince of Yunnan Yesun Temur must not be carried out on one's own.

s0414.literal: " An edict ordered Eastern Campaign pacification commissioners Tatardai and Yang Uludai to lead ten thousand men against Guwei; Yang Uludai was granted a triple-pearl tiger tally and made Eastern Campaign pacification commissioner and commander-in-chief.
s0414.idiomatic: " An edict ordered Eastern Campaign pacification commissioners Tatardai and Yang Uludai to lead 10,000 men against Guwei; Yang Uludai received a triple-pearl tiger tally and was made Eastern Campaign pacification commissioner and commander-in-chief.

s0415.literal: On renzi day Changge and Yancheng each presented auspicious fungus.
s0415.idiomatic: On renzi day Changge and Yancheng each presented auspicious fungus.

s0416.literal: On guichou day the Eastern Expedition Branch Secretariat was established; Atahai was made left grand councillor, Liu Guojie and Chen Yan were both left vice councillors, Hong Chachiu was right vice councillor, to campaign against Japan.
s0416.idiomatic: On guichou day the Eastern Expedition branch secretariat was established; Atahai was made left grand councillor, Liu Guojie and Chen Yan were both left vice councillors, Hong Chachiu was right vice councillor, to campaign against Japan.

s0417.literal: Seals were granted to Tuolichaan, Dajiguasan, and others, ordering them to audit the Central Secretariat, with rank equivalent to rank three.
s0417.idiomatic: Seals were granted to Tuolichaan, Dajiguasan, and others to audit the Central Secretariat at rank equivalent to grade three.

s0418.literal: On bingchen day councilor Timur was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat, ranking above Guo You, and he was charged: "From now on all affairs are your responsibility.
s0418.idiomatic: On bingchen day councilor Timur was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat, ranking above Guo You, and charged, "From now on all affairs are your responsibility.

s0419.literal: " The Kingdom of Ma-fa sent tribute.
s0419.idiomatic: " The Kingdom of Ma-fa sent tribute.

s0420.literal: On wuwu day Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat grand councillor Mangudai was made left grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.
s0420.idiomatic: On wuwu day Jiang-Huai branch secretariat grand councillor Mangudai was made left grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat.

s0421.literal: Initially Western Sichuan had only four circuits; Ahmad had abusively expanded offices to nine; censorial officials said the region had few people — Guangyuan, Chengdu, Shunqing, Chongqing, and Kuizhou circuits were retained, and the rest were all abolished.
s0421.idiomatic: Initially Western Sichuan had only four circuits; Ahmad had abusively expanded offices to nine; censorial officials said the region had too few people — Guangyuan, Chengdu, Shunqing, Chongqing, and Kuizhou were retained and the rest abolished.

s0422.literal: Later, because of the strategic mountain valleys and mixed barbarian settlement, Jiading Route and Xuzhou Pacification Commission were re-established to control the area.
s0422.idiomatic: Later, because of strategic valleys and mixed barbarian settlement, Jiading Route and the Xuzhou pacification commission were re-established to control the area.

s0423.literal: The Court of Review was promoted to the Office of the Chief Defender of Justice, rank two subordinate.
s0423.idiomatic: The Court of Review was promoted to the Office of the Chief Defender of Justice at subordinate rank two.

s0424.literal: The Chief Defender's Office reported that the people of Helahe Prefecture were starving; each household was given two oxen and two shi of seed grain, and additionally one hundred sixteen thousand four hundred ingots of paper currency to purchase sixty thousand four hundred shi of rice as four months' famine relief.
s0424.idiomatic: The Chief Defender's Office reported famine in Helahe Prefecture; each household received two oxen and two shi of seed grain, plus 116,400 ingots of paper currency to buy 60,400 shi of rice as four months' relief.

s0425.literal: On guihai day because Dajiguasan's audit of accumulated years' revenue and grain had set up a separate agency at odds with the secretariat departments, disturbing government affairs, it was merged into the secretariat.
s0425.idiomatic: On guihai day Dajiguasan's audit of accumulated revenue and grain, which had set up a separate agency at odds with the secretariat and disturbed government affairs, was merged back into the secretariat.

s0426.literal: On dingmao day the Privy Council was ordered to account for transport ships at Jiao, Lai, and other places, sea vessels built in Goryeo and Jiangnan, and requisition hired civilian ships from Jiang-Huai, to prepare for the Japan expedition.
s0426.idiomatic: On dingmao day the privy council was ordered to account for transport ships at Jiao, Lai, and elsewhere, sea vessels built in Goryeo and Jiangnan, and requisitioned civilian ships from Jiang-Huai for the Japan expedition.

s0427.literal: It was further ordered that those trained in open-sea sailing should recruit sailors — those reaching a thousand men to be qianhu, those reaching a hundred to be baihu.
s0427.idiomatic: It was further ordered that those trained in open-sea sailing should recruit sailors — groups of 1,000 to be qianhu and groups of 100 to be baihu.

s0428.literal: Ta Hai's younger brother Liushi said: "Now commoners and peoples of various appanages are all ordered to build ships in Jurchen territory, while Jurchen are again being conscripted as soldiers — corvée labor is extremely heavy.
s0428.idiomatic: Ta Hai's younger brother Liushi said, "Commoners and peoples of various appanages are all ordered to build ships in Jurchen territory while Jurchen are again conscripted as soldiers — corvée labor is extremely heavy.

s0429.literal: The eagle-hunting and gold-mining households of the appanages of Nayan and Shennahe'er alone are not being levied.
s0429.idiomatic: The eagle-hunting and gold-mining households of the appanages of Nayan and Shennahe'er alone are not being levied.

s0430.literal: " An imperial instruction ordered envoys dispatched to levy their people.
s0430.idiomatic: " An imperial instruction ordered envoys dispatched to levy their people.

s0431.literal: Wumeng tribal pacification commissioner Ameng rebelled; an edict halted the campaign against Luobidan troops and ordered the Yunnan Branch Secretariat to join in dispatching troops to suppress him.
s0431.idiomatic: Wumeng tribal pacification commissioner Ameng rebelled; an edict halted the Luobidan campaign and ordered the Yunnan branch secretariat to join in suppressing him.

s0432.literal: Guo You said: "Since the pacification of Jiangnan, within ten years revenue and grain affairs have been audited eight times.
s0432.idiomatic: Guo You said, "Since the pacification of Jiangnan, revenue and grain affairs have been audited eight times in ten years.

s0433.literal: Now Dajiguasan and others are again conducting audits; they should be dismissed immediately.
s0433.idiomatic: Now Dajiguasan and others are auditing again; they should be dismissed immediately.

s0435.literal: Eleventh month, on the jisi new moon, Guangdong pacification commissioner Yuedeshimi said the three circuits of Yingde, Xun, and Mei had few people and asked they be changed to prefectures; he also asked that garrison commander Yuyue be made Huizhou zongguan and Weizhou prefectural magistrate Mubala be made Chaozhou darughachi.
s0435.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jisi new moon, Guangdong pacification commissioner Yuedeshimi said Yingde, Xun, and Mei circuits had too few people and asked they be changed to prefectures; he also asked garrison commander Yuyue be made Huizhou zongguan and Weizhou prefect Mubala be made Chaozhou darughachi.

s0436.literal: The emperor suspected him of acting arbitrarily and denied the request.
s0436.idiomatic: The emperor suspected him of acting arbitrarily and denied the request.

s0437.literal: Censorate officials said: "The Censorate and Surveillance Commissions have the duty of investigating officials; recently those auditing revenue and grain fear exposure of their wrongdoing and have privately gathered unruly elements to obstruct the work — we ask Your Majesty to instruct them according to the old regulations.
s0437.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "The censorate and surveillance commissions exist to investigate officials; those now auditing revenue and grain fear exposure of their wrongdoing and have gathered unruly elements to obstruct the work — we ask Your Majesty to instruct them according to the old regulations.

s0439.literal: " On gengwu day Prince Ayachi was granted a silver seal.
s0439.idiomatic: " On gengwu day Prince Ayachi was granted a silver seal.

s0440.literal: On renshen day, for the campaign against Japan, Abachi was dispatched to oversee Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat military supplies, and Chahu was dispatched to oversee Liaodong Branch Secretariat military supplies.
s0440.idiomatic: On renshen day, for the campaign against Japan, Abachi was dispatched to oversee Jiang-Huai branch secretariat military supplies and Chahu to oversee Liaodong branch secretariat military supplies.

s0441.literal: On jiaxu day relay stations for Helazhang, Sichuan, Jiandu, and others were established.
s0441.idiomatic: On jiaxu day relay stations were established at Helazhang, Sichuan, Jiandu, and elsewhere.

s0442.literal: On wuyin day envoys were dispatched informing Goryeo to raise ten thousand troops and six hundred fifty ships to assist the Japan expedition, and also ordering more ships built nearby.
s0442.idiomatic: On wuyin day envoys informed Goryeo to raise 10,000 troops and 650 ships for the Japan expedition and to build more ships nearby.

s0443.literal: On jichou day one hundred twenty-three households of the Bufahua family in Chongqing Prefecture were registered as commoners.
s0443.idiomatic: On jichou day 123 households of the Bufahua family in Chongqing Prefecture were registered as commoners.

s0444.literal: Censorate officials memorialized: "Formerly the Song enlisted unmarried strong men as salt troops, totaling five thousand; today one thousand one hundred twenty-two remain, habitually violent, causing the people great suffering — they should be given clothing and grain and made to garrison-farm for self-support.
s0444.idiomatic: Censorate officials memorialized, "Formerly the Song enlisted unmarried strong men as salt troops, 5,000 in all; 1,122 remain today, habitually violent and a burden on the people — they should be given clothing and grain and made to garrison-farm for self-support.

s0445.literal: " An edict ordered deliberation and implementation.
s0445.idiomatic: " An edict ordered deliberation and implementation.

s0446.literal: On guisi day an edict ordered one million shi of Jiang-Huai grain transported by canal, shipped by sea, and stored at Hap'o in Goryeo; Tokyo and Goryeo were each also ordered to store one hundred thousand shi for the Japan expedition.
s0446.idiomatic: On guisi day an edict ordered 1 million shi of Jiang-Huai grain transported by canal and sea to Hap'o in Goryeo; Tokyo and Goryeo were each also to store 100,000 shi for the Japan expedition.

s0447.literal: All armies were scheduled to depart in sequence starting the third month of next year and assemble at Hap'o in the eighth month.
s0447.idiomatic: All armies were to depart in sequence from the third month of the next year and assemble at Hap'o in the eighth month.

s0448.literal: On yiwei day Tulughuan was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat, and Lu Shirong was executed.
s0448.idiomatic: On yiwei day Tulughuan was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat and Lu Shirong was executed.

s0449.literal: On bingshen day prisoners were pardoned, their faces tattooed, and Song-era private salt smuggling troops skilled in sea routes were recruited as sailors for the Japan expedition.
s0449.idiomatic: On bingshen day prisoners were pardoned and tattooed, and Song-era private salt smugglers skilled at sea routes were recruited as sailors for the Japan expedition.

s0450.literal: Twelfth month, an edict reduced sentences of prisoners throughout the realm.
s0450.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict reduced sentences of prisoners throughout the realm.

s0451.literal: Because they had fled back from Champa, Huduhu, Liu Jiu, and Tian Er were restored to their former posts to join the Japan expedition.
s0451.idiomatic: Because they had fled back from Champa, Huduhu, Liu Jiu, and Tian Er were restored to their former posts for the Japan expedition.

s0452.literal: Ten thousand additional campaign troops and fifty Muslim catapult specialists were added to Atahai's Japan expedition force.
s0452.idiomatic: 10,000 additional campaign troops and 50 Muslim catapult specialists were added to Atahai's Japan expedition force.

s0453.literal: On jihai day, acceding to the Privy Council's request, military register regulations were strictly established and strong men and powerful households were selected for military service.
s0453.idiomatic: On jihai day, acceding to the privy council's request, military register regulations were strictly established and strong men and powerful households were selected for service.

s0454.literal: An edict to the Privy Council: "Formerly because of the Japan expedition the Five Guard armies were sent home to prepare equipment; now select strong men in full, to reach the capital by the first day of the first month.
s0454.idiomatic: An edict to the privy council said, "Formerly the Five Guard armies were sent home to prepare equipment for the Japan expedition; now select strong men in full to reach the capital by the first day of the first month.

s0455.literal: " The Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat drilled naval combat on the river with one thousand warships.
s0455.idiomatic: " The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat drilled naval combat on the river with 1,000 warships.

s0456.literal: On xinchou day Dajiguasan's associates Cai Zhongying and Li Xi were executed.
s0456.idiomatic: On xinchou day Dajiguasan's associates Cai Zhongying and Li Xi were executed.

s0457.literal: On dingwei day the crown prince died.
s0457.idiomatic: On dingwei day the crown prince died.

s0458.literal: On wuwu day four thousand Central Guard troops felled fifty-eight thousand six hundred trees for repairs at Wan'an Temple.
s0458.idiomatic: On wuwu day 4,000 Central Guard troops felled 58,600 trees for repairs at Wan'an Temple.

s0459.literal: On jiwei day the pillars of the Imperial Ancestral Temple were painted red.
s0459.idiomatic: On jiwei day the pillars of the Imperial Ancestral Temple were painted red.

s0460.literal: On yiyou day the Academy of Gathered Worthies was established, with Jariman placed in charge.
s0460.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Academy of Gathered Worthies was established under Jariman.

s0461.literal: On wuzi day the Helazhang gold-washing supervision office and commander-in-chief post were abolished.
s0461.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Helazhang gold-washing supervision office and commander-in-chief post were abolished.

s0462.literal: An edict ordered Helazhang chiefs' sons sent as hostages to the capital, and qianhu and baihu sons left as hostages with Prince of Yunnan Yesun Temur.
s0462.idiomatic: An edict ordered Helazhang chiefs' sons sent as hostages to the capital and qianhu and baihu sons left as hostages with Prince of Yunnan Yesun Temur.

s0463.literal: Central Secretariat officials memorialized: "Nasuding said reducing superfluous Helazhang officials could save nine hundred forty-six liang of salary gold annually;
s0463.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials memorialized, "Nasuding said reducing superfluous Helazhang officials could save 946 liang of salary gold annually;

s0464.literal: and appointing dedicated overseers of garrison-farm revenue could yield five thousand liang of gold annually.
s0464.idiomatic: and appointing dedicated overseers of garrison-farm revenue could yield 5,000 liang of gold annually.

s0466.literal: Zhibige and others were dispatched to audit the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.
s0466.idiomatic: Zhibige and others were dispatched to audit the Yunnan branch secretariat.

s0467.literal: On gengyin day an edict forbade transfer and rotation of artisan officials.
s0467.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict forbade transfer and rotation of artisan officials.

s0468.literal: On xinmao day an edict ordered the relevant offices to sacrifice to the Northern Dipper.
s0468.idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict ordered the relevant offices to sacrifice to the Northern Dipper.

s0469.literal: That year the Jiang-Zhe Transport Commission was ordered to administer all tax items comprehensively.
s0469.idiomatic: That year the Jiang-Zhe transport commission was ordered to administer all tax items comprehensively.

s0470.literal: Forty thousand monks from all routes were gathered at Pu'en Temple in the Western Capital for a seven-night ordination assembly.
s0470.idiomatic: 40,000 monks from all routes were gathered at Pu'en Temple in the Western Capital for a seven-night ordination assembly.

s0471.literal: Prefectures and counties at Chongqing and elsewhere were consolidated.
s0471.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties at Chongqing and elsewhere were consolidated.

s0472.literal: Champa Branch Secretariat associate administrator Yiqihumishi and others, returning with the army, were stationed at four overseas prefectures; they sent messengers to report, and an edict released their army to return.
s0472.idiomatic: Champa branch secretariat associate administrator Yiqihumishi and others, returning with the army, were stationed at four overseas prefectures; they sent messengers to report, and an edict released their army to return.

s0473.literal: Prince Tuohuan, princes Arugui, Jijibuhua, Princess Nangiazhen, and others were granted a total of seven thousand seven hundred thirty-two ingots of paper currency, six hundred twenty-nine horses, one hundred bolts of cloth, one thousand bows, and twenty thousand arrows.
s0473.idiomatic: Prince Tuohuan, princes Arugui and Jijibuhua, Princess Nangiazhen, and others received 7,732 ingots of paper currency, 629 horses, 100 bolts of cloth, 1,000 bows, and 20,000 arrows.

s0474.literal: Princes Azhiji, Hé'erlu, Mangudai, Songhu'er, Asha, Hedan, Biehela, and others, and official households scattered in Hexi, were granted thirty-seven thousand seven hundred fifty-seven ingots of paper currency as price for sheep and horses, four thousand bolts of cloth, and two thousand bolts of silk.
s0474.idiomatic: Princes Azhiji, Hé'erlu, Mangudai, Songhu'er, Asha, Hedan, Biehela, and others, and official households scattered in Hexi, received 37,757 ingots of paper currency as price for sheep and horses, 4,000 bolts of cloth, and 2,000 bolts of silk.

s0475.literal: Because Bapala and others were impoverished, seventy-six thousand five hundred two ingots of paper currency were granted.
s0475.idiomatic: Because Bapala and others were impoverished, 76,502 ingots of paper currency were granted.

s0476.literal: Princes Azhiji, Xiaosi, Commander Wang, Biesudai, Yesun, and others, and the armies campaigning against Burma and Champa, were rewarded with fifty-three thousand five hundred forty-one ingots of paper currency, eight thousand one hundred ninety-seven horses, sixteen thousand six hundred thirty-four sheep, eleven oxen, twenty-two thousand one hundred shi of rice, eighty-one thousand bolts of silk cloth, five hundred thirty jin of cotton, twenty-seven thousand two hundred seventy-nine bolts of cotton cloth, one thousand suits of armor and bedding, one thousand bows, and one hundred seventy-nine sets of clothing.
s0476.idiomatic: Princes Azhiji, Xiaosi, Commander Wang, Biesudai, Yesun, and others, and the Burma and Champa campaign armies, were rewarded with 53,541 ingots of paper currency, 8,197 horses, 16,634 sheep, 11 oxen, 22,100 shi of rice, 81,000 bolts of silk cloth, 530 jin of cotton, 27,279 bolts of cotton cloth, 1,000 suits of armor and bedding, 1,000 bows, and 179 sets of clothing.

s0477.literal: The Imperial Preceptor Yelianbaheshili, Luosi'erba, and others were ordered to conduct Tibetan Buddhist rites in rotation at Wan'an, Xingjiao, Qingshou, and other temples, nineteen assemblies in all.
s0477.idiomatic: The imperial preceptor Yelianbaheshili, Luosi'erba, and others were ordered to conduct Tibetan Buddhist rites in rotation at Wan'an, Xingjiao, Qingshou, and other temples — 19 assemblies in all.

s0478.literal: Two hundred seventy-one persons were sentenced to death.
